name: ParkFree
description: Evidence-aware parking intelligence with FastAPI, PostGIS, deterministic regulation evaluation, availability prediction, routing, and an interactive map demo.

paragraphs: ParkFree is an evidence-aware parking intelligence system. It keeps curb legality, payment status, predicted vacancy, and search-route optimization separate, then combines them into a traceable parking approach instead of pretending that a single score is ground truth.

The hosted demo uses clearly labeled fixtures so anyone can explore the complete interface without sharing a location or depending on a third-party API. The local application provides the real FastAPI/PostGIS pipeline and optional zero-key US destination and road discovery.
features: deterministic LEGAL / ILLEGAL / UNKNOWN and FREE / PAID / UNKNOWN regulation contracts;
PostGIS candidate segments with stable IDs and spatial indexing;
versioned availability estimates with uncertainty and reproducible feature snapshots;
destination search and on-demand US road coverage through bounded provider adapters;
